question.en: How do global gender indices influence policy-making in India? Discuss with reference to the Gender Inequality Index.
question.hi: How do global gender indices influence policy-making in India? Discuss with reference to the Gender Inequality Index.

modelAnswer.en: Indices provide data-driven insights into gender disparities. They highlight areas like health, education, and labor force participation, prompting targeted government interventions like Beti Bachao Beti Padhao and skill development programs.
